As a host and Superhost, I feel Airbnb does not protect hosts enough from unsupported accusations. Guests should be able to leave negative feedback, but publicly implying a host “scammed” them without evidence is very damaging. In my case, the guest was refunded and the message history showed we acted in good faith, yet Airbnb allowed the review to remain. Hosts need fair protection too, not only generic policy replies.
